meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 可以检查和管理 Azure 订阅的配额（服务限制），包括查看当前使用量、可用容量，比较不同区域的配额，并提交增加请求。
howto.when: 当用户提到“检查配额”、“服务限制”、“当前用量”、“请求增加配额”、“配额超限”、“验证容量”、“区域可用性”或“vCPU 限制”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 查一下美国东部区域的 vCPU 配额使用情况。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本返回配额限制、用量和可用量。

say.text: 帮我把 Standard DSv3 系列配额增加到 500。
say.note: Claude 会执行配额增加请求并反馈状态。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude helps you check and manage Azure quotas (service limits): view usage, available capacity, compare across regions, and request increases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users say phrases like "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", or "vCPU limit".

say_en.text: Check vCPU quota usage in East US region.
say_en.note: Claude runs the script and returns limits, usage, and available.

say_en.text: Compare available capacity of Standard DSv3 family between westus2 and eastus2.
say_en.note: Claude queries each region and shows comparison.

say_en.text: Increase my Standard DSv3 family quota to 500.
say_en.note: Claude submits increase request and reports status.
